mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS target_id, t.application_id, va.student_id, su.staff_no, su.name AS student_name, t.preference_no, t.score, t.tie_order, t.scored_at, va.resume_file_id, rf.original_name AS resume_file_name, o.id AS offer_id, o.status AS offer_status, o.confirm_deadline, CASE WHEN fa.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS student_admitted FROM application_target t JOIN volunteer_application va ON va.id = t.application_id JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = va.student_id LEFT JOIN resume_file rf ON rf.id = va.resume_file_id LEFT JOIN offer o ON o.application_target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN final_admission fa ON fa.student_id = va.student_id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND va.round_no = #{roundNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.score IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.score DESC, CASE WHEN t.tie_order IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.tie_order ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.application_id, t.teacher_id, va.student_id, va.round_no, t.score, t.tie_order, t.scored_at FROM application_target t JOIN volunteer_application va ON va.id = t.application_id WHERE t.id = #{targetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE application_target SET score = #{score}, scored_at = #{scoredAt}, tie_order = NULL WHERE id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS target_id, t.application_id, va.student_id, su.staff_no, su.name AS student_name, t.score, t.tie_order FROM application_target t JOIN volunteer_application va ON va.id = t.application_id JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = va.student_id WHERE t.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND va.round_no = #{roundNo} AND t.score IS NOT NULL AND t.score >= #{cutoffScore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM final_admission fa WHERE fa.student_id = va.student_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM offer o WHERE o.application_target_id = t.id ) ORDER BY t.score DESC, CASE WHEN t.tie_order IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.tie_order ASC, t.id ASC
